@graph.name: dmlex.ttl
@graph.description: Source OWL ontology this schema was converted from

@graph.name: Convert OWL ontology to MASP schema crate

@graph.rdfs:label: CollocateMarker
@graph.name: Collocate Marker
@graph.rdfs:comment: Marks up a substring other than the headword inside an example, inside an example translation or inside a definition. Constraints: exactly 1 endIndex; at most 1 lemma; exactly 1 startIndex.

@graph.rdfs:label: Definition
@graph.name: Definition
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one of possibly several definitions of a sense. Constraints: at most 1 definitionType; exactly 1 listingOrder; exactly 1 text.

@graph.rdfs:label: DefinitionTypeTag
@graph.name: Definition Type Tag
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one (of many) possible values for definitionType of definition. Constraints: at most 1 description; exactly 1 tag.

@graph.rdfs:label: Entry
@graph.name: Entry
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents a dictionary entry. Constraints: exactly 1 headword; at most 1 homographNumber.

@graph.rdfs:label: Etymology
@graph.name: Etymology
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents a chain of historical derivations of a word. Constraints: at most 1 description; exactly 1 listingOrder.

@graph.rdfs:label: Etymon
@graph.name: Etymon
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one stage (of possibly several) in the etymological history of the headword. Constraints: at least 1 etymonUnit; exactly 1 listingOrder; at most 1 note; at most 1 translation; at most 1 type; at most 1 when.

@graph.rdfs:label: EtymonLanguage
@graph.name: Etymon Language
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one of several allowed values for the language property of etymonUnit objects. Constraints: at most 1 displayName; exactly 1 langCode.

@graph.rdfs:label: EtymonType
@graph.name: Etymon Type
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one of possible values for the type of etymon. Constraints: at most 1 description; exactly 1 type.

@graph.rdfs:label: EtymonUnit
@graph.name: Etymon Unit
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents a form (typically a word) which is the etymological origin of the headword, or another etymologically related form. Constraints: exactly 1 language; exactly 1 listingOrder; at most 1 reconstructed; exactly 1 text; at most 1 translation.

@graph.rdfs:label: Example
@graph.name: Example
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents a sentence or other text fragment which illustrates the headword being used. Constraints: exactly 1 listingOrder; at most 1 soundFile; at most 1 sourceElaboration; at most 1 sourceIdentity; exactly 1 text.

@graph.rdfs:label: ExampleTranslation
@graph.name: Example Translation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents the translation of an example. Constraints: at most 1 language; exactly 1 text.

@graph.rdfs:label: HeadwordExplanation
@graph.name: Headword Explanation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents a statement in the translation language which explains (but does not translate) the meaning of the headword. Constraints: at most 1 language; exactly 1 text.

@graph.rdfs:label: HeadwordMarker
@graph.name: Headword Marker
@graph.rdfs:comment: Marks up a substring inside an example, inside an example translation or inside a definition which corresponds to the headword (or to a translation of the headword). Constraints: exactly 1 endIndex; exactly 1 startIndex.

@graph.rdfs:label: HeadwordTranslation
@graph.name: Headword Translation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one of possibly multiple translations of a headword. Constraints: at most 1 language; exactly 1 listingOrder; exactly 1 text.

@graph.rdfs:label: InflectedForm
@graph.name: Inflected Form
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one (of possibly many) inflected forms of the headword. Constraints: exactly 1 listingOrder; at most 1 tag; exactly 1 text.

@graph.rdfs:label: InflectedFormTag
@graph.name: Inflected Form Tag
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one (of many) possible values for tag of inflectedForm. Constraints: at most 1 description; at most 1 forHeadwords; at most 1 forTranslations; exactly 1 tag.

@graph.rdfs:label: Label
@graph.name: Label
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents a restriction on its parent such as temporal (old-fashioned, neologism), regional (dialect), register (formal, colloquial), domain (medicine, politics) or grammar (singular-only). Constraints: exactly 1 listingOrder; exactly 1 tag.

@graph.rdfs:label: LabelTag
@graph.name: Label Tag
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one (of many) possible values for tag of label. Constraints: at most 1 description; at most 1 forCollocates; at most 1 forHeadwords; at most 1 forTranslations; exactly 1 tag; at most 1 typeTag.

@graph.rdfs:label: LabelTypeTag
@graph.name: Label Type Tag
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one (of many) possible values for typeTag of labelTag. Constraints: exactly 1 description; exactly 1 tag.

@graph.rdfs:label: LexicographicResource
@graph.name: Lexicographic resource
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents a dictionary. Constraints: exactly 1 langCode; at most 1 title; at most 1 uri.

@graph.rdfs:label: Member
@graph.name: Member
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents the fact that an object, such as an entry or a sense, is a member of a relation. Constraints: exactly 1 listingOrder; at most 1 obverseListingOrder; exactly 1 ref; at most 1 role.

@graph.rdfs:label: MemberType
@graph.name: Member Type
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one of possible values for the role of member, as well as various restrictions on members having this role. Constraints: at most 1 action; at most 1 description; at most 1 max; at most 1 min; at most 1 role; exactly 1 type.

@graph.rdfs:label: PartOfSpeech
@graph.name: Part of Speech
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents a part of speech label. Constraints: exactly 1 listingOrder; exactly 1 tag.

@graph.rdfs:label: PartOfSpeechTag
@graph.name: Part of Speech Tag
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one (of many) possible values for tag of partOfSpeech. Constraints: at most 1 description; at most 1 forEtymology; at most 1 forHeadwords; at most 1 forTranslations; exactly 1 tag.

@graph.rdfs:label: PlaceholderMarker
@graph.name: Placeholder Marker
@graph.rdfs:comment: Marks up a substring inside a headword or inside a headword translation which is not part of the expression itself but stands for things that can take its place. Constraints: exactly 1 endIndex; exactly 1 startIndex.

@graph.rdfs:label: Pronunciation
@graph.name: Pronunciation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents the pronunciation of its parent. Pronunciations must have either a sound file or a transcription. Constraints: exactly 1 listingOrder; at most 1 soundFile.

@graph.rdfs:label: Relation
@graph.name: Relation
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents the fact that a relation exists between two or more objects. Constraints: at most 1 description; at least 2 member; exactly 1 type.

@graph.rdfs:label: RelationType
@graph.name: Relation Type
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one of possible values for the type of relation. Constraints: at most 1 description; at most 1 scope; exactly 1 type.

@graph.rdfs:label: Sense
@graph.name: Sense
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one of possibly many meanings (or meaning potentials) of the headword. Constraints: at most 1 indicator; exactly 1 listingOrder.

@graph.rdfs:label: SourceIdentityTag
@graph.name: Source Identity Tag
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one (of many) possible values for sourceIdentity of example. Constraints: at most 1 description; exactly 1 tag.

@graph.rdfs:label: Transcription
@graph.name: Transcription
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents the transcription of a pronunciation in some notation such as IPA. Constraints: exactly 1 listingOrder; at most 1 scheme; exactly 1 text.

@graph.rdfs:label: TranscriptionSchemeTag
@graph.name: Transcription Scheme Tag
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one (of many) possible values for scheme of transcription. Constraints: at most 1 description; at most 1 forHeadwords; at most 1 forTranslations; exactly 1 tag.

@graph.rdfs:label: TranslationLanguage
@graph.name: TranslationLanguage
@graph.rdfs:comment: Represents one of the languages in which translations are given in this lexicographic resource. Constraints: exactly 1 langCode; exactly 1 listingOrder.

@graph.rdfs:label: inflectedForm
@graph.name: Inflected Form
@graph.rdfs:comment: Inflected Form. A sub-property of otherForm.
